notes.title: Patch#6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a [Mod Warehouse] to the Production Zone and adjusted module spawn rates.​​
[*] ​​Removed the prerequisite for unlocking the [Dismantle] function—it’s now available immediately after repairing the [Research Center].
[/list]

notes.content:
